gaps.sentence: ___ being the youngest competitor, she won the gold medal.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite being...' is the standard concessive pattern with a gerund.

gaps.sentence: The drug is remarkably effective. ___, it has almost no side effects.
gaps.explanation: 'Furthermore' introduces an additional point supporting the same claim.

gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: She has decided to cycle to work ___ taking the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' = in place of the bus journey.

gaps.sentence: The prototype is undeniably elegant; it is, ___, hopelessly impractical.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' concedes elegance while introducing the drawback.

gaps.sentence: She is not only a gifted violinist ___ a composer of some note.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only A but also B' joins the two parallel noun phrases.

gaps.sentence: ___ being remarkably fast, the new chip consumes far less power.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides + -ing' adds a further advantage; 'despite of' does not exist.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.
